evidence.paraphrase: Fay explains the taxi contains a suction pump driven by the engine that evacuates the air from the sealed passenger compartment, with reinforced windows and frame.
evidence.quote:
There
s a suction pump on
the engine that
s exhausting the air from the cab. The driver started
the pump when she started the cab. The windows and framework are built
to withstand enormous outside pressure.

evidence.paraphrase: Fay describes how the murder taxi was rigged with a suction pipe and automatic snap locks to kill anyone who entered.
evidence.quote:
His taxi
was equipped with a suction pipe and a set of snap locks on the doors.
It was death to enter it.

evidence.paraphrase: Hilton states that Stephney was killed by an unknown method after being lured to his death.
evidence.quote:
He was killed by an unknown method. He was
lured to death in the heart of civilization!

evidence.paraphrase: An autopsy detected an abnormal condition of the lungs and a greenish-black face, providing forensic clues to the cause of death.
evidence.quote:
It was he
who detected the condition of the lungs. Also, Stephney
s face was
greenish-black.

evidence.paraphrase: Elsie explains they tracked the suspect by a distinctive tire mark left in the dust.
evidence.quote:
he had
different tires than most cars. One was vulcanized on the tread and
made a different mark in the dust.

evidence.paraphrase: Rake reacts in alarm as he notices the air in the cab is being drawn out.
evidence.quote:
The air
s gettin
 thinner!
 exclaimed Rake. 
I can
t breathe!

evidence.paraphrase: A new taxi company staffed by paroled ex-convicts operates in the city.
evidence.quote:
I
ve always been interested in this new company
with the gray taxies and the paroled men who drive them.

evidence.paraphrase: The victim was suffocated to death and then his body disposed of onto a freight train.
evidence.quote:
Stephney was suffocated
and completely out of this life when his body was dropped on top of the
train.

evidence.paraphrase: Elsie physically reacts with shock upon learning Stephney was murdered.
evidence.quote: The girl swayed. She reached blindly for the arms of the chair.
